title: Move read_keytab_file to /epan
description:
The read_keytab_file function is used at the UI layer, so it should be moved out of dissection functionality so /epan can be more independent.

Also, renamed read_keytab_file to keytab_file_read to keep consistent naming convention within the file.

notes.body: @AndersBroman - I know it's been a while since you wrote this, but what do you think of the "refactor"?
I think I just ported this from the handwritten dissector to the asn1 generated one.

Here's what I know:
1. Only the MacOS pipeline tests are failing by "crashing" on the test_kerberos test
2. To crash it requires a keytab file and decryption enabled
3. If I modify the contents of the keytab file to _intentionally_ have the keys mismatch, the test still crashes.
4. When I restore the original "read_keytab_file" the test passes, but the keytab_file_read is logically equivalent (and works on the other OSes)
5. During early development, I saw a "crash" on all OSes because read_keytab_file had changed since I originally wrote the branch (and rebasing didn't catch it) where the keys now use wmem strings and memory and not fixed character arrays.
6. Tried making all keys epan_scoped in case there was some logic that cleaned up the pinfo->pool memory "more strictly" on the MacOS - didn't help.

Hmmmmm.  That'd do it!  Now how'd that happen?...

So it looks like the existing code depended on `read_keytab_file` to initialize the `krb5_ctx` (in `packet-kerberos.c`) which would later be used during dissection.

The new code calls `keytab_file_read`, which initializes its own `krb5_ctx` (local to `epan/read_keytab_file.c`) but leaves the one in `packet-kerberos.c` untouched, so that `decrypt_krb5_data_cb` subsequently calls into `krb5_c_decrypt` with a `NULL` context, leading to the crash.
THANK YOU!  Still a little surprised why this doesn't crash on all platforms, but I can now at least make a fix.

commits_data.title: Move read_keytab_file to /epan
commits_data.message:
Move read_keytab_file to /epan

The read_keytab_file function is used at the UI layer, so it should be moved out of dissection functionality so /epan can be more independent.

Also, renamed read_keytab_file to keytab_file_read to keep consistent naming convention within the file.

Also added some const to wmem map API so that some of the wmem maps "shared" by read_keytab_file module can be const
